name: Hekimu
source:
Hekimu is a short horror visual novel where the goal is to escape from a bizarre dream world. One day, the protagonist is trapped within a nightmare and finds themselves in a room with four creepy walls and no exit. While the protagonist is aware that they are trapped in a dream, they are unable to wake themselves. In order to escape from this nightmarish world, they must investigate their surroundings.

Players progress through the game by exploring the room using point-and-click gameplay.

The background images used in the game were created with the AI program [url=https://www.midjourney.com/]Midjourney[/url], which generates images based on textual descriptions.

[From [url=https://automaton-media.com/en/news/20220816-14966/]AUTOMATON WEST[/url]]
translation:
《Hekimu》是一部短篇恐怖视觉小说，目标是逃离一个古怪的梦境世界。某天，主人公被困在噩梦之中，醒来时身处一间四面墙壁诡异、没有出口的房间。主人公知道自己身在梦中，却无法让自己醒来。为了逃出这个噩梦般的世界，主人公必须调查周围环境。

玩家通过点击并探索房间来推进游戏。

本作使用的背景图由[url=https://www.midjourney.com/]Midjourney[/url]生成；该AI程序可以根据文字描述生成图像。

[来源：[url=https://automaton-media.com/en/news/20220816-14966/]AUTOMATON WEST[/url]]
